verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (now LegalZoom Virtual Mail) is a SaaS software service, so asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question. The evidence shows only a published OpenAPI spec and an MCP tool catalog. Those are interface descriptions, not the product's source code, and nothing in the pack mentions an open-source license or a public repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
